name: tg-sniper
description: NFT mint-sniper Telegram bot — primary target: Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum Orbit L2) via OpenSea

scripts.check: node --check bot.js && for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax OK'

comments.@metaplex-foundation/mpl-candy-machine: Listed in the spec but NOT installed: the Solana Candy Machine path is a documented stub (see src/chains/solana/candyMachine.js). Add it when that path is implemented rather than carrying an unused heavy dependency.
comments.node-cron: Not installed. The scheduler uses native setTimeout because cron's 1-second resolution is too coarse for a mint war — see src/scheduler/scheduler.js.
comments.ethers: v6 — note the v5 -> v6 API differences (BigInt everywhere, FetchRequest, provider.broadcastTransaction).
